text: DSH Shadow Mind（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让独立的后台 Shadow agent 在根 agent 完成包含工具调用的回合后复核任务执行情况。它将推理之外的会话轨迹投影给新建子 agent，并要求通过结构化输出提交发现，再由运行时校验、批量整理并回传到原会话。用户可以在设置页配置 Shadow 定义、激活概率、模型路线和上下文选项，也能在对话卡片查看结果、重试失败运行或暂停复核。适合希望为 DSH 的代码操作增加独立复核的人；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 和 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24+，无需额外 API key。

DSH Shadow Mind reviews DSH tool-using turns with background agents. Each child inspects a reasoning-free trajectory and can relay validated structured findings. The Web UI offers configuration, run status, retry, and pause controls. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and Node.js 22.19+ or 24+.
想让 DSH 在 agent 用完工具后自动再做一次独立复核。
有没有办法让另一个后台 agent 检查 DSH 刚完成的工作？
我希望复核结果能作为结构化报告回到原来的会话。
想在 DSH 设置页调整审查 agent 使用的模型和激活概率。
DSH 工具操作完成后，怎样让后台检查遗漏和结论矛盾？
需要一个能查看每次复核状态并重试失败任务的对话界面。
需要复核 agent 只引用实际看到的会话事件，方便核对发现依据。
Can a separate background agent review a DSH turn after it uses tools?
I want structured findings from an independent reviewer to appear in the same session.
I need per-session controls to pause reviews and retry a failed run from its result card.
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「后台回合复核」：根 agent 完成使用过工具的回合后，按激活概率安排新 Shadow 子 agent 检查会话轨迹。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「结构化复核结果」：子 agent 必须调用 structured_output 提交结果；运行时校验状态、结论、严重度和可引用的轨迹序号。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「报告批量回传」：已接受的复核报告进入固定时间窗口，批次整理后写回对应根会话。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「轨迹投影」：为子 agent 提供带序号的会话文本，默认隐藏推理和工具结果正文，并可按配置隐藏工具参数。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「Shadow 定义与模型配置」：定义文件支持概率、模型路线、工具、捕获窗口、上下文继承和 think-first 选项。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「管理命令和工具」：提供 /shadow new 手动启动复核，并注册列出 Shadow、更新默认定义和读写调度设置的工具。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「Web 复核卡片」：对话卡片展示运行状态和结果，支持重试失败运行、暂停或恢复调度，并可打开子会话。
DSH Shadow Mind 的功能「设置页面」：在 Settings → Plugins 提供默认 Shadow 配置、状态、模型目录和卡片折叠偏好。
DSH Shadow Mind 使用前须知：它需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，并要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24+。
DSH Shadow Mind 使用前须知：工具参数默认隐藏，也可在调度设置中改为完整披露；Shadow 定义和可选调试日志位于 DSH_HOME。

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · dsh-shadow-mind：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

An independently versioned DeepSeek Harness bundle that starts fresh background Shadow agents after eligible tool-using root turns, validates their structured findings, relays accepted reports into the root session, and exposes configuration and evidence in the Web UI.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Version Compatibility：| dsh-shadow-mind | DSH Version Required | Notes |
|----------------|---------------------|-------|
| v0.1.7 | `0.2.1-rc.2` | Desktop / Web, managed Shadow activation lifecycle |
| v0.1.6 | `0.2.0-rc.2` | ConfigForms, profile settings, and think-first tool declaration fix |
| v0.1.3–v0.1.4 | `0.1.6-alpha.2` | Codec factories and Workspace-owned Session navigation |
| v0.1.2         | `0.1.5-rc.2` (verified baseline) | Subagent setup binding + live degenerate-output watchdog |
| v0.1.1         | `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0` | Session API compatibility update |
| v0.1.0         | `0.1.4` and earlier | Legacy session API |

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Version Compatibility：**Current release**: v0.1.7 targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. v0.1.6 targets the older DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; other DSH versions require separate validation.

If you're using DSH `0.1.4` or earlier, please install `dsh-shadow-mind@0.1.0`:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind#v0.1.0
```

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Inspiration：The core design idea for this project comes from [pi-shadow-mind](https://github.com/liuzhengdongfortest/pi-shadow-mind.git). This repository is an independent implementation for the DeepSeek Harness plugin system, not an official fork of that project. Its runtime, Sessions, subagents, permissions, persistence, and Web UI use DeepSeek Harness extension mechanisms.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Install：Install the immutable release tag, or download the package tarball from the [v0.1.7 Release](https://github.com/whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind/releases/tag/v0.1.7):

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add github:whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind#v0.1.7
```

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Desktop：Use the CLI bundled with the installed application and set `DSH_HOME` to the home actually used by Desktop. Fully quit Desktop first and reopen it after the command finishes:

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = '<actual Desktop DSH_HOME>'
& 'G:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add '<absolute tarball path>'
```

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Desktop：Desktop independently owns `profiles/desktop`. Installing into an npm CLI Web profile does not verify Desktop installation. After restarting, open **Settings → Built-in Plugins → Shadow Mind**, then use a real file-reading tool turn to verify the review card. See the [v0.1.7 compatibility notes](docs/releases/v0.1.7.md) for installation and rollback.

Or pin a reviewed commit when installing from GitHub:

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Desktop：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind#<commit-sha>
```

Install a local checkout during development:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-shadow-mind
```

Restart the selected profile after installation. Verify the composed rows without starting the Web server:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output must contain `shadow-mind-runtime` and `tool-shadow-mind`. Update by running `add` with a new reviewed SHA. Remove the bundle with:

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Desktop：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind
```

GitHub installation consumes the committed `lib/` directory. This package has no `prepare` script and does not require pnpm `allowBuilds` authorization.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Configure：Definitions are stored in `$DSH_HOME/shadow-minds/*.md`. A minimal deterministic acceptance definition is:

```markdown
---
id: acceptance-reviewer
name: Acceptance Reviewer
enabled: true

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Configure：Set the definition's `activation_probability` to `1` for deterministic acceptance. If `run_with_model` is omitted, the child inherits the root route; set a complete `provider/model` route to use another model. The default Shadow tools are `read`, `grep`, and `glob`; definition tools extend that allowlist and may carry write authority if the inherited sandbox permits it. The disabled starter library under [`examples/shadow-minds/`](examples/shadow-minds/) demonstrates the anchored probe vocabulary and is never installed into `$DSH_HOME` automatically.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Bind Shadows to DSH models：Every Shadow child can be bound to the DSH deployment's configured providers, models, and reasoning efforts. The Settings page offers linked provider/model/effort dropdowns populated from the live DSH LLM directory, including each model's adapter-advertised reasoning efforts. Leaving a field empty inherits the default: the root route for provider/model, and the selected model's default effort for reasoning. The stored wire format remains the `provider/model` route string, so model-facing management tools are unchanged.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Observe a run：Shadow scheduling requires a completed root turn containing at least one durable tool result. In a new session, ask the root agent to read a repository file and analyze it. One human command covers the case automatic scheduling misses: `/shadow new` forces an immediate review while this session has not admitted any Shadow run yet. After that, the per-turn conversation card owns the run controls: its Retry button re-runs a specific failed or aborted run, and the Pause/Resume button in the card header stops or restarts scheduling for the session (pausing also cancels admitted work). Active runs, total admitted runs, and the last outcome stay visible on the settings page and the per-turn conversation cards.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Observe a run：When Shadow scheduling starts, a running placeholder appears immediately below the reviewed root response and warns that sending a new message cancels the review. The same card updates in place to report, silent, not-relevant, aborted, or failed. Repeated reviews remain at their actual turn positions. Report bodies use DSH's Markdown renderer for GFM, tables, code blocks, and TeX with its unsafe-content filtering.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Observe a run：An accepted report becomes a durable root user message and triggers a follow-up, but that relay updates the existing anchored card instead of adding a tail card. `silent`, `not_relevant`, `aborted`, and `failed` remain visible without entering the root agent, so presentation state cannot create a Shadow loop. A `silent` or `not_relevant` output that carries an explanatory body is tolerated: its body text is never relayed, the run settles as the declared status instead of failing validation (only a `report` carries body text), the discarded body is reported through a runtime warning that names the Shadow and run id, and a `non-report-body-discarded` debug record captures its presence, length, and content hash when `debug: true` is set.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Observe a run：Set `debug: true` on a definition when diagnosing production behavior. `$DSH_HOME/shadow-minds/logs/<shadow-id>.jsonl` records admission, child start, cancellation request, terminal outcome, and report delivery with lifecycle stage, stable reason code, cancellation source, and provider stop reason. It excludes prompts, report bodies, tool arguments, credentials, absolute paths, and stacks; a discarded non-report body is represented only by its length and SHA-256 hash. For example, new user input is `USER_MESSAGE_RECEIVED`, a Shadow deadline is `SHADOW_TIMEOUT`, and an abort not attributed to the plugin is `PROVIDER_ABORTED`.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Debugging a failure：A failure report usually arrives as only a subagent error message or a child subagent session id. The zero-dependency [`tools/shadow-debug.mjs`](tools/shadow-debug.mjs) reconstructs the full run context from either fragment:

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Debugging a failure：```sh
node tools/shadow-debug.mjs trace <childSessionId|runId|rootSessionId>   # one run: timeline + inputs + child-session evidence
node tools/shadow-debug.mjs find <error text|reason code>                 # locate runs by error content
node tools/shadow-debug.mjs runs [--failed] [--shadow <id>]               # list recent runs
node tools/shadow-debug.mjs health                                        # definition debug flags and log health

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Debugging a failure：It resolves `$DSH_HOME/shadow-minds/logs/*.jsonl` (run timeline and input metadata), `$DSH_HOME/shadow-minds/<id>.md` (definition and review prompt), and `$DSH_HOME/sessions/*/<childSessionId>/session.jsonl.zstd` (the full child event stream: prompt, LLM request headers, tool errors, turn termination). When run inside a DSH session it infers paths from environment variables. The [Chinese debugging guide](docs/debugging.zh.md) documents the workflow, reason-code/stage tables, and a symptom-to-evidence map; an equivalent agent skill ships at [`.agents/skills/shadow-debug/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/shadow-debug/SKILL.md).

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Security and limitations：The default trajectory projection omits reasoning, raw tool-result text, and tool arguments. Prompt injection remains possible in projected user and assistant text, so tool allowlists, inherited sandbox policy, fixed child approval policy, and disclosure limits remain security controls.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Security and limitations：Definitions apply to one Harness home rather than one profile or workspace. Child Sessions follow the Harness persistence policy. Concurrent Shadows do not share a transaction, and write-capable tools can race with the root agent or other Shadows.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Security and limitations：This plugin is developed and released from its own repository and is installed into a Harness profile as a bundle. An earlier in-repo copy of the plugin (`packages/shadow-mind` in the Harness source tree) predates this standalone repository and still uses the older `{status, content}` structured-output contract without `verdict`/`severity`/`refs`; it is not part of this repository's build or install path and is not updated here. Fixes in this repository apply to the released bundle only.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Security and limitations：Accepted reports and their anchored cards survive a service restart. Runtime counters, the latest-run diagnostic, non-report lifecycle cards, and pause state are current-process data. The current release also resets `spentChars` on restart, so a restart can reopen a configured soft or hard budget before the next real user message.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Security and limitations：Follow the [installation and runtime validation plan](docs/installation-runtime-validation.md) for a reproducible source-host deployment, real-model acceptance run, restart checks, and the budget-persistence remediation. See the [target architecture](docs/target-architecture.md), [review conditioning](docs/review-conditioning.md), and [review-quality directions](docs/review-quality-directions.md) for current runtime contracts. The [settings field tiers](docs/settings-ux-analysis.md) document which Web form fields are required, common, advanced, or intentionally not exposed. [The Chinese technical design](docs/technical-design.zh.md) retains the Pi reference analysis and independent release topology. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before publishing logs or changing an installation pin.

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Development：The devDependencies link against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` source (`../deepseek-harness`, a sibling of this checkout). Prepare the commit pinned by `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:

```sh
corepack enable
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git ../deepseek-harness
git -C ../deepseek-harness checkout 687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317
pnpm --dir ../deepseek-harness install --frozen-lockfile

@whutzefengxie-ops/dsh-shadow-mind README · Development：Then install and check this repository (`CI=1` skips pnpm's interactive confirmation when the modules directory must be rebuilt from scratch):

```sh
CI=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run check
```

`lib/` is a reviewed release artifact and must be committed whenever source behavior changes. Never commit local Harness state, credentials, sessions, logs, or acceptance exports.
